_comment: Helper config for the RSFQ test-bench tools. Design-derived values (clock frequency, PTL delay, core pitch, die size, I/O nets) are exported by the app to die.tb.json next to die.cir; anything set here overrides or supplements them. Run the tools from this directory (or pass --config).
_comment2: Stimulus knobs. clockPeriodPs <= 0 means derive it from freqGHz in die.tb.json (period = 1000/freqGHz). launchOffsetPs is the clock pulse start; dataPhasePs is how much later each data pulse starts (the routed data paths are shorter than the clock tree, so data must lag the clock). PTL TD is per 10um block (blocks come from the app's core pitch). pipelineLatencySlots is the counterflow latency added to the run length; timeStepPs/josimMaxRows keep JoSIM's time-point memory in check (measured: 80k points OK, 100k crashed on an 8 GB box).
